phrasings.literal: What are the current status and priority of task #277 on main?
phrasings.short: #277 status and priority
phrasings.paraphrased: How urgent is the interest management task #277 at the moment, and what state is it in?

gold_query: MATCH (t {id: #277}) RETURN t.status, t.priority
notes: SD §5.5 and §7 s84: c.main-c4-prio moved #277 from P2 to P0 on main, where it is open (SD §11.1). The P3 on lane/net is that lane's side of a FieldEdit conflict (SD §10), not main's value.

phrasings.literal: Show findings #501, #502 and #503 together with the status each of them has now.
phrasings.short: findings #501, #502, #503 with their status
phrasings.paraphrased: Where did the three first-round review findings #501, #502 and #503 end up?

gold_query: MATCH (n) WHERE n IN [#501, #502, #503] RETURN n, n.status
notes: SD §5.9 and §7 s14-s15: c.refute-a-r1 confirmed #501 and refuted #502; c.withdraw-a-r1 withdrew #503. The named form passes the id list as ids=501,502,503 ([50 §6.1]).

phrasings.literal: Which rule is recorded as contradicting rule #214?
phrasings.short: rule contradicting #214
phrasings.paraphrased: Rule #214 says to import textures at full resolution; which other rule is it at odds with?

gold_query: MATCH (r:rule)-[:CONTRADICTS]-(#214) RETURN r
notes: SD §6: the only CONTRADICTS edge is #215->#214; the kind is symmetric ([50 §2.5]), so a pattern in either direction finds #215 once because #214 is bound.

phrasings.literal: On lane/net, which sections of the snapshot plan is finding #1303 about?
phrasings.short: sections finding #1303 is about, on lane/net
phrasings.paraphrased: Finding #1303 came out of the net lane's review; which parts of the snapshot plan does it concern there?

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (#1303)-[:ABOUT]->(s) RETURN s
notes: SD §4 and §6: #1303 exists only on lane/net (c.net-review) and is ABOUT #283 and #284; asked on main it would give no rows and N06 (SD §4).

phrasings.literal: Task #293 was deleted on main; which node was named as its replacement, and what reason was recorded?
phrasings.short: deleted #293: replacement and deletion reason
phrasings.paraphrased: What took the place of the removed reader registry task #293, and what reason was given for removing it?

gold_query: MATCH (x:DELETED {id: #293}) RETURN x.replaced_by, x.deleted_reason
notes: SD §5.8 and §7 s55: c.x1-delete ran DELETE #293 REPLACED BY #294 REASON 'superseded by v2'; the tombstone keeps replaced_by and deleted_reason ([50 §3.6]). A plain lookup of #293 returns no rows and N01.

phrasings.literal: Какая задача на main называется «Спектральный анализатор»?
phrasings.short: задача «Спектральный анализатор»
phrasings.paraphrased: Найди задачу с заголовком «Спектральный анализатор»: какой у неё номер?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.title = 'Спектральный анализатор' RETURN t
notes: SD §5.4: #266 has this Cyrillic title and no other task shares it. SD §14: the term анализатор occurs only in #266's title and body, so find kind=task text=анализатор returns the same single node.

phrasings.literal: У какой заметки в заголовке есть слова «потере пакетов»?
phrasings.short: заметка со словами «потере пакетов» в заголовке
phrasings.paraphrased: Найди заметку, название которой упоминает «потере пакетов».

gold_query: MATCH (n:note) WHERE n.title CONTAINS 'потере пакетов' RETURN n
notes: SD §5.2: #234's title is 'Буфер снимков переполняется при потере пакетов'; no other title contains the phrase. SD §14: пакетов occurs only in #234's title and body, so find kind=note text=пакетов gives the same node.

phrasings.literal: Which active rules with critical criticality apply to the file path src/net/tick.rs?
phrasings.short: active critical rules for src/net/tick.rs
phrasings.paraphrased: Before I touch src/net/tick.rs, which critical rules currently in force cover that file?

gold_query: MATCH (r:rule) WHERE r.status = 'active' AND r.criticality = 'critical' AND applies(r, 'src/net/tick.rs') RETURN r
notes: SD §5.2 and §5.10: the active rules covering src/net/tick.rs are #207 (empty applies_to = every path), #210, #213 and #218; the critical ones are #207 and #218. #208 and #209 are critical but scoped to src/render/** and src/audio/**; #219 (src/net/handshake/**) is normal.

phrasings.literal: Which decision answers question #226?
phrasings.short: decision answering #226
phrasings.paraphrased: Question #226 on the mixer latency budget counts as answered; which decision supplied the answer?

gold_query: MATCH (d:decision)-[:ANSWERS]->(#226) RETURN d
notes: SD §6: ANSWERS #222->#226 is the only ANSWERS edge; #226 is answered (SD §5.2, §11.1).

phrasings.literal: Who created verdict #804, acting in which role, and at what time?
phrasings.short: creator, role and creation time of verdict #804
phrasings.paraphrased: Which agent recorded the round-two architecture verdict #804, in what role, and when was it recorded?

gold_query: MATCH (v {id: #804}) RETURN v.created_by, v.created_role, v.created_at
notes: SD §7 s38: c.verdict-a-r2 at D4 12:00 (2026-06-05, SD §2.1) by crit#1, whose role is architecture-critic; created_by, created_role and created_at are the creating commit's actor, role and time (SD §2.1, §2.2).

phrasings.literal: Which findings about sections of the snapshot plan #282 exist on lane/net but not on main?
phrasings.short: findings about #282's sections on lane/net, not on main
phrasings.paraphrased: Compared with main, which findings concerning the sections of the snapshot plan #282 are new on the net lane?

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (f:finding) WHERE EXISTS { (f)-[:ABOUT]->(s) WHERE s IN subtree(#282) } RETURN f EXCEPT MATCH (f:finding) WHERE EXISTS { (f)-[:ABOUT]->(s) WHERE s IN subtree(#282) } RETURN f
notes: SD §6: on lane/net the findings ABOUT #283 or #284 are #603, #1301, #1302 and #1303 (#1304 has no ABOUT edge); on main only #603 is. #1301-#1303 exist only on lane/net (SD §4). Existence of the conflicted #603 is not affected by its StatusFork (SD §10).

phrasings.literal: Show the task tree under #285, including #285 itself, with the status of each task.
phrasings.short: tree of #285 with statuses
phrasings.paraphrased: Lay out the build tooling cleanup #285 and everything beneath it, saying where each piece stands.

gold_query: CALL subtree(#285, depth: 3) YIELD node RETURN node, node.status
notes: SD §5.6 and §7 s53: after c.merge-tools #286, #287 and #289 are done and #288 cancelled on main; #285 is open. The subtree includes its root at depth 0 ([50 §2.6]).

phrasings.literal: Which nodes have been deleted on main without any replacement being named?
phrasings.short: nodes deleted on main with no replacement
phrasings.paraphrased: On main, what has been removed outright, with nothing designated to take its place?

gold_query: MATCH (x:DELETED) WHERE x.replaced_by IS NULL RETURN x
notes: SD §5.8 and §11.1: main's tombstones are #232, #293 and #296; #293 has replaced_by #294, while #232 (c.x6-delete) and #296 (c.x4-delete) have none. #299 and #251 are deleted only on lane/shaders and lane/assets.

phrasings.literal: Which direct subtasks of #260 are still open on main but already done on lane/audio?
phrasings.short: #260 subtasks open on main, done on lane/audio
phrasings.paraphrased: In the audio mixer rewrite #260, which immediate subtasks has the audio lane finished that main still shows as open?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#260) WHERE t.status = 'open' RETURN t INTERSECT USE lane/audio MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#260) WHERE t.status = 'done' RETURN t
notes: SD §5.4 and §11.2: on main every child of #260 is open except #267 (frozen); on lane/audio #261 and #262 are done (c.audio-b1-done, c.audio-b2-done) and #264 is in_progress.

phrasings.literal: List the open tasks labelled net whose priority is P1 or more important.
phrasings.short: open net tasks with priority P0 or P1
phrasings.paraphrased: Which still-open tasks carrying the net label are ranked P0 or P1?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.priority <= 1 AND 'net' IN t.labels RETURN t
notes: SD §13: the net label is on #273-#281 and #297. On main #278 (P2) and #279 (P3) fail the priority test and #281 is cancelled (SD §5.5); #276 is open on main (in_progress only on lane/net). The named form uses the argv range prio=..1 ([50 §6.1]).

phrasings.literal: For plan #254, give for each review round the number of findings about its sections, how many of them are confirmed, how many refuted, and how many are confirmed with blocker or important severity.
phrasings.short: review loop numbers per round for plan #254
phrasings.paraphrased: How is the review of the asset pipeline plan #254 converging? Per round, count the findings on its sections: raised, confirmed, refuted, and confirmed ones of blocker or important severity.

gold_query: MATCH (f:finding) WHERE EXISTS { (f)-[:ABOUT]->(s) WHERE s IN subtree(#254) } RETURN f.round AS round, count(*) AS raised, count(CASE WHEN f.status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 END) AS confirmed, count(CASE WHEN f.status = 'refuted' THEN 1 END) AS refuted, count(CASE WHEN f.status = 'confirmed' AND f.severity IN ['blocker', 'important'] THEN 1 END) AS blocking ORDER BY round
notes: SD §5.9, §5.10 and §6: round 1 findings about #255-#259 are #501 (confirmed, blocker), #502 (refuted), #503 (withdrawn), #504 (fixed); round 2 are #801 (confirmed, important), #802 and #803 (open). #502 and #803 are about two sections each, so the existence test keeps each finding once; #505 has no ABOUT edge.

phrasings.literal: For the findings raised by agents in the architecture-critic role, give per round how many were raised, how many were refuted, and the refuted percentage rounded to one decimal place.
phrasings.short: architecture-critic findings per round: raised, refuted, refuted percent
phrasings.paraphrased: How often do the architecture critic's findings get refuted? Per round, show raised, refuted, and the percentage refuted to one decimal place.

gold_query: MATCH (f:finding) WHERE f.created_role = 'architecture-critic' WITH f.round AS round, count(*) AS raised, count(CASE WHEN f.status = 'refuted' THEN 1 END) AS refuted RETURN round, raised, refuted, round(100.0 * refuted / raised, 1) AS pct ORDER BY round
notes: SD §5.9 and §5.10: architecture-critic findings on main are #501-#504 and #603 in round 1 (only #502 refuted: 1/5 = 20.0 %) and #801-#803 in round 2 (none refuted). #603 is confirmed on main (c.main-fc1-confirm); filler findings are created by orch as orchestrator (SD §12.2).

phrasings.literal: On average, how many sections of plan #254 is a finding about, taken over the findings that are about at least one of its sections?
phrasings.short: average number of #254 sections per finding about them
phrasings.paraphrased: Findings on the asset pipeline plan #254 can cover several of its sections; what is the mean number of its sections per such finding?

gold_query: MATCH (f:finding)-[:ABOUT]->(s) WHERE s IN subtree(#254) RETURN count(*) / count(DISTINCT f) AS avg_sections
notes: SD §6: 9 ABOUT edges run from findings into #255-#259 (#502 and #803 are about two sections each) from 7 distinct findings (#501-#504, #801-#803); 9 / 7 = 1.2857142857 as a float ([50 §3.3]).

phrasings.literal: How many artifacts in total did the runs executed in lane #700 produce or consume?
phrasings.short: artifacts produced or consumed by runs in lane #700
phrasings.paraphrased: Across every run executed in the net lane #700, what is the number of artifacts produced plus the number consumed?

gold_query: MATCH (r:run)-[:RUNS_IN]->(#700), (r)-[:PRODUCED|CONSUMED]->(a) RETURN count(*)
notes: SD §5.9 and §6: the only run is #1701, which RUNS_IN #700, PRODUCED #307 and CONSUMED #305: two bindings, one per edge.

phrasings.literal: What fraction of the sections of plan #254 have at least one finding in status confirmed about them, as a number between 0 and 1?
phrasings.short: fraction of #254's sections with a confirmed finding
phrasings.paraphrased: Of the asset pipeline plan #254's sections, what proportion has a confirmed finding pointing at it, expressed as a fraction?

gold_query: MATCH (s:doc)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#254) RETURN count(CASE WHEN EXISTS { (f:finding)-[:ABOUT]->(s) WHERE f.status = 'confirmed' } THEN 1 END) / count(*) AS share
notes: SD §5.3, §5.9 and §6: #254 has five sections #255-#259; the confirmed findings about them are #501 and #801, both about #256 only (#504 is fixed, not confirmed; #505 has no ABOUT edge), so 1 of 5 sections: 0.2.

phrasings.literal: How many different agents created the findings that exist on main?
phrasings.short: number of distinct creators of findings on main
phrasings.paraphrased: Counting each author once, how many distinct agents wrote the findings present on main?

gold_query: MATCH (f:finding) RETURN count(DISTINCT f.created_by)
notes: SD §5.9, §7 and §12.2: on main the findings were created by crit#1 (#501-#504, #603, #801-#803), ref#1 (#505) and orch (the 175 filler findings); FN-1...FN-R1 exist only on lane/net.

phrasings.literal: How many different findings are about a section of plan #254 that itself depends on some other section?
phrasings.short: distinct findings about #254 sections that depend on another section
phrasings.paraphrased: Among the sections of #254 that rely on another section, how many distinct findings point at at least one of them?

gold_query: MATCH (f:finding)-[:ABOUT]->(s)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->() WHERE s IN subtree(#254) RETURN count(DISTINCT f)
notes: SD §6: #256-#259 have DEPENDS_ON out-edges, #255 has none. Findings about them: #501 and #801 (#256), #502 (#257, #258), #802 (#257), #803 (#258, #259), #503 (#259): 6 distinct; the fixed pattern binds 10 times because #259 depends on two sections and #502 and #803 are about two.

phrasings.literal: How many sections does section #259 depend on, directly or through other sections?
phrasings.short: number of sections #259 depends on, direct or indirect
phrasings.paraphrased: Following dependency links as far as they go, how many distinct sections does the rollout section #259 rest on?

gold_query: MATCH (#259)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->+(s) RETURN count(*)
notes: SD §6: #259->#258->#257->#256->#255 plus the shortcut #259->#255; the endpoints are #255-#258 (4). Two paths reach #255, but a quantified part binds endpoint pairs ([50 §3.4] item 4).

phrasings.literal: In plan #254, how many ordered pairs of sections (a, b) are there such that a depends on b directly or through other sections?
phrasings.short: direct-or-indirect section dependency pairs in plan #254
phrasings.paraphrased: Counting each (dependent, prerequisite) pair once, how many direct or transitive dependency relations exist among the asset pipeline plan #254's sections?

gold_query: MATCH (a)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->+(b) WHERE a IN subtree(#254) RETURN count(*)
notes: SD §6: the chain #259->#258->#257->#256->#255 with the shortcut #259->#255 gives 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10 reachable pairs (from #256, #257, #258, #259); the pair (#259, #255) counts once although two paths exist.

phrasings.literal: Following direct prerequisite links between tasks, how many distinct tasks does #241 have to finish before, directly or through other tasks, regardless of their current status?
phrasings.short: number of tasks downstream of #241 via prerequisite links
phrasings.paraphrased: Counting each once, how many tasks can be reached from the manifest schema task #241 by following 'must finish before' links forward?

gold_query: MATCH (#241)-[:BLOCKS]->+(t:task) RETURN count(*)
notes: SD §6: #241->#243, #241->#245 (shortcut), #243->#245, #243->#244, #245->#246, #245->#248; the endpoints are #243, #244, #245, #246, #248 (5). There are 8 paths, but endpoint pairs are counted ([50 §3.4] item 4). #249 and #250 are blocked only by inheritance through their parent #248 (SD §11.5), so no link reaches them.

phrasings.literal: Counting finished and unfinished tasks alike, which tasks directly block more than one other task, and how many tasks does each of them block?
phrasings.short: tasks directly blocking two or more tasks, with counts
phrasings.paraphrased: Find the tasks that are a direct prerequisite of several other tasks, whatever their status, and the number of tasks each one holds up.

gold_query: MATCH (b:task)-[:BLOCKS]->() WITH b, count(*) AS n WHERE n > 1 RETURN b, n
notes: SD §6: on main #241 (#243, #245), #243 (#244, #245), #245 (#246, #248), #274 (#275, #280) and #276 (#277, #280) have two BLOCKS out-edges each; every other source has one (#294->#295 after the re-point, #252->#251); the flagged edge from the tombstone #296 binds no live node ([50 §3.6]).

phrasings.literal: Сколько действующих правил распространяется на файл src/audio/mixer.rs, отдельно по каждому уровню критичности, начиная с самого критичного?
phrasings.short: действующие правила для src/audio/mixer.rs по критичности
phrasings.paraphrased: Разбей правила, которые сейчас действуют для src/audio/mixer.rs, по критичности и посчитай их; самые критичные — первыми.

gold_query: MATCH (r:rule) WHERE r.status = 'active' AND applies(r, 'src/audio/mixer.rs') RETURN r.criticality AS criticality, count(*) AS rules ORDER BY criticality
notes: SD §5.2: the active rules covering src/audio/mixer.rs are #207 (empty applies_to, critical), #209 (src/audio/**, critical) and #213 (src/**, normal); #212 also covers it but is superseded. Criticality sorts by declared rank, critical first ([50 §3.5]).

phrasings.literal: For each blocked task in the tree of #273, how many unfinished tasks directly block it? List the most blocked first.
phrasings.short: blocked tasks under #273 by number of unfinished direct blockers
phrasings.paraphrased: Within the netcode snapshots campaign #273, which tasks are held up, and by how many unfinished direct prerequisites each? Worst first.

gold_query: MATCH (b)-[:BLOCKS]->(t:task) WHERE t IN subtree(#273) AND t.blocked AND b.unfinished RETURN t, count(*) AS open_prereqs ORDER BY open_prereqs DESC
notes: SD §11.1 and §11.5: on main the blocked tasks in #273's tree are #275 (blocked by #274), #277 (by #276) and #280 (by #274, #275, #276); all of these blockers are open, so each count equals open_blockers.

phrasings.literal: What percentage of the direct subtasks of #240 are finished, counting cancelled subtasks as finished? Round to one decimal place.
phrasings.short: percent of #240's direct subtasks done or cancelled, one decimal
phrasings.paraphrased: Of the tasks sitting immediately under the asset pipeline campaign #240, what share in percent is completed or cancelled, to one decimal?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#240) RETURN round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN t.done THEN 1 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct

phrasings.literal: List every direct subtask of #273 with the number of tasks it directly blocks, including those that block none.
phrasings.short: #273 subtasks with count of tasks each blocks, zeros included
phrasings.paraphrased: For each immediate subtask of the netcode snapshots campaign #273, how many other tasks wait directly on it? Show zero where none do.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#273) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:BLOCKS]->(d) RETURN t, count(d) AS blocks
notes: SD §5.5 and §6: #273's children on main are #274-#281; #274 blocks #275 and #280, #275 blocks #280, #276 blocks #277 and #280, and #277-#281 block nothing on main (#279->#278 exists only on plan/q3). count(d) gives 0 where the optional part did not match.
